name: System Port
description: Inventory compatibility requirements, port separate scopes, integrate them once, and independently verify required user journeys.
when_to_use: Use when moving a system to another platform, language, or interface while preserving explicitly agreed user-visible behavior.

stages.title: Inventory compatibility: {goal}
stages.description: Inventory {goal}. Create a journey matrix that separates required behavior, explicitly excluded behavior, compatibility boundaries, and unknowns. Assign non-overlapping core and interface scopes for the parallel stages. Record the exact input revision and environment; request a scope decision when compatibility expectations are unclear.
acceptance: Inventory defines required user journeys, approved exclusions, compatibility boundaries, and separate implementation scopes

stages.title: Port core behavior: {goal}
stages.description: Implement only the core scope assigned by the inventory in a registered isolated workspace. Use the environment's VCS and checkout tools. Run `{test_command}` for the assigned journeys, record the exact resulting revision, and provide a local change artifact the integration owner can apply.
acceptance: Core implementation maps every assigned required journey to verification and provides an exact revision for integration

stages.title: Port interfaces and adapters: {goal}
stages.description: Implement only the interface scope assigned by the inventory in a separate registered workspace. Use the environment's VCS and checkout tools. Run `{test_command}` for assigned compatibility contracts and provide an exact revision and local change artifact to the integration owner.
acceptance: Interface implementation preserves assigned compatibility contracts and provides an exact revision for integration

stages.title: Integrate port slices: {goal}
stages.description: Act as the sole integration owner. Inspect both exact revisions and combine their changes in a registered isolated workspace using the configured VCS tools. Resolve conflicts and contradictory assumptions explicitly. Run `{test_command}` and record one exact integrated revision for independent verification.
acceptance: Integration revision incorporates both slices and resolves conflicting assumptions

stages.title: Verify all user journeys: {goal}
stages.description: Independently run `{test_command}` and the entire required journey matrix on the exact integrated revision. Do not modify the implementation or publish a change. Produce a local review artifact mapping each journey to evidence. Required failures or missing evidence block completion; document exclusions only when the mission or an explicit scope decision accepts them.
acceptance: Every required journey passes on the exact integrated revision, and any excluded behavior has an explicit accepted scope decision
